title: 真实VXLAN隧道PMTUD故障：小HTTPS成功而大响应重传，只恢复被误丢的ICMP反馈
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
body:
## 操作任务
实现repair(router_pid,interface,approved_pref)。隔离夹具已证明VXLAN封装后较小的中间链路需要IPv4 ICMP type3/code4反馈，唯一获批删除的是指定接口egress pref10的该反馈drop规则；另一个pref20规则及clsact必须保留，不改路由、接口MTU或隧道。只删除明确批准pref；重复执行无该规则时安全返回。真实HTTPS小响应仍成功，大响应因反馈丢弃超时且TCP重传计数增加。修复后大响应完整内容哈希必须正确，原策略和链路配置保持。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Linux内核VXLAN/UDP封装、三私有网络命名空间、路由转发与1400字节中间链路，TLS1.2证书与对端名称校验开启；临时自签CA仅由本次客户端显式信任。实际tc精确丢弃type3/code4使大响应停顿并出现内核TCP重传，删除该规则后真实完整65536字节HTTPS传输恢复。测试只用自有user/net namespace与veth，不改外层网络、宿主信任库、默认身份或默认配置，不安装模块、不构建镜像。不声称任意隧道或生产防火墙通用修复；删除范围已由夹具批准，仅处理本题错误反馈过滤规则，其他ICMP策略保留。
rubric: 验证恢复结果与回退条件

conversion.original_title: HTTPS 小请求成功，大响应停住；抓包显示同一大段重复重传，隧道新增加封装且 ICMP 反馈被丢弃。如何恢复？

"""Real VXLAN, a smaller transit link, blocked fragmentation-needed and TLS transfer recovery."""
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,secrets,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
import task
assert os.geteuid()==0
workers=[]
def run(*args):return subprocess.check_output(args,text=True,timeout=8)
def inside(peer,*args):return run('nsenter','-t',str(peer.pid),'-n',*args)
def rpc(peer,**data):
 peer.stdin.write(json.dumps(data)+'\n');peer.stdin.flush();line=peer.stdout.readline();assert line,'worker exited';result=json.loads(line);assert result['ok'],result;return result['result']
try:
 for _ in range(3):
  peer=subprocess.Popen(['unshare','-n','--',sys.executable,'-I','-B','checks/pmtud_worker.py'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True);workers.append(peer);ready=json.loads(peer.stdout.readline());assert ready['ready'] and ready['pid']==peer.pid
 client,router,server=workers
 for peer in workers:inside(peer,'ip','link','set','lo','up')
 for endpoint,ename,rname,network in [(client,'eth0','rc','198.18.0'),(server,'eth0','rs','198.19.0')]:
  a='a'+rname;b='b'+rname;run('ip','link','add',a,'type','veth','peer','name',b)
  run('ip','link','set',a,'netns',str(endpoint.pid));run('ip','link','set',b,'netns',str(router.pid))
  inside(endpoint,'ip','link','set',a,'name',ename);inside(router,'ip','link','set',b,'name',rname)
  for peer,name,host in [(endpoint,ename,1),(router,rname,254)]:inside(peer,'ip','link','set',name,'up');inside(peer,'ip','addr','add',network+'.'+str(host)+'/24','dev',name)
 inside(router,'sysctl','-qw','net.ipv4.ip_forward=1')
 for peer,local,remote,gateway in [(client,'198.18.0.1','198.19.0.1','198.18.0.254'),(server,'198.19.0.1','198.18.0.1','198.19.0.254')]:
  inside(peer,'ip','route','add',remote+'/32','via',gateway,'dev','eth0')
  inside(peer,'ip','link','add','vx0','type','vxlan','id','42','dev','eth0','local',local,'remote',remote,'dstport','4789','df','inherit')
  inside(peer,'ip','link','set','vx0','mtu','1450');inside(peer,'ip','link','set','vx0','up');inside(peer,'ip','addr','add','192.0.2.'+('1' if peer is client else '2')+'/24','dev','vx0');inside(peer,'sysctl','-qw','net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=0')
 root=pathlib.Path.cwd();cert=str(root/'certificate.pem');key=str(root/'private.key')
 run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',key)
 run('openssl','req','-new','-x509','-key',key,'-out',cert,'-days','1','-subj','/CN=192.0.2.2','-addext','subjectAltName=IP:192.0.2.2')
 small=secrets.token_bytes(24);large=secrets.token_bytes(65536)
 rpc(server,op='serve',certificate=cert,key=key,small=small.hex(),large=large.hex())
 def get(path):return rpc(client,op='https',certificate=cert,path=path,timeout=3)
 expected_small={'status':200,'bytes':len(small),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(small).hexdigest()};expected_large={'status':200,'bytes':len(large),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(large).hexdigest()}
 assert get('/small')==expected_small and get('/large')==expected_large,'healthy HTTPS over actual VXLAN baseline'
 rpc(server,op='capture')
 inside(router,'tc','qdisc','add','dev','rs','clsact')
 for pref,typecode in [('10','0x0304'),('20','0x0800')]:inside(router,'tc','filter','add','dev','rs','egress','protocol','ip','pref',pref,'u32','match','ip','protocol','1','0xff','match','u16',typecode,'0xffff','at','20','action','drop')
 inside(router,'ip','link','set','rc','mtu','1400')
 before_retrans=rpc(server,op='retrans');assert get('/small')==expected_small,'small verified HTTPS must remain usable';failure=get('/large');assert 'failed' in failure,failure
 after_retrans=rpc(server,op='retrans');assert after_retrans>before_retrans,'actual endpoint TCP retransmissions required'
 capture_before=rpc(server,op='capture_stats');assert capture_before['same_large_tcp_segment_max_observations']>=2 and capture_before['oversized_df_vxlan_packets']>0 and capture_before['received_fragmentation_needed']==0,capture_before
 filters=json.loads(inside(router,'tc','-s','-j','filter','show','dev','rs','egress'));assert any(r.get('pref')==10 for r in filters)
 before_routes={str(p.pid):json.loads(inside(p,'ip','-j','route','show')) for p in workers}
 print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: real VXLAN HTTPS small response succeeds, large response times out with actual TCP retransmissions when fragmentation-needed is dropped',flush=True)
 task.repair(router.pid,'rs',10)
 assert get('/large')==expected_large,'full large HTTPS body must recover with exact fresh payload hash'
 capture_after=rpc(server,op='capture_stats');assert capture_after['received_fragmentation_needed']>0,capture_after
 assert get('/small')==expected_small
 filters=json.loads(inside(router,'tc','-j','filter','show','dev','rs','egress'));assert not any(r.get('pref')==10 for r in filters) and any(r.get('pref')==20 for r in filters),'unrelated ICMP policy must survive'
 for p in workers:assert json.loads(inside(p,'ip','-j','route','show'))==before_routes[str(p.pid)]
 assert json.loads(inside(router,'ip','-j','link','show','dev','rc'))[0]['mtu']==1400
 for p in [client,server]:assert json.loads(inside(p,'ip','-j','link','show','dev','vx0'))[0]['mtu']==1450
 task.repair(router.pid,'rs',10);assert get('/large')==expected_large
 print('NATIVE_REAL_VXLAN_TLS_SMALL_OK_LARGE_TIMEOUT_TCP_RETRANSMITS_REMOVE_ONLY_FRAGMENTATION_NEEDED_DROP_FULL_BODY_HASH_RECOVERS_OTHER_ICMP_POLICY_ROUTES_AND_MTUS_PRESERVED',flush=True)
 print('NATIVE_PACKET_CAPTURE_SAME_LARGE_TCP_SEQUENCE_REPEATED_OVERSIZED_VXLAN_DF_SEEN_FEEDBACK_ABSENT_BEFORE_AND_RECEIVED_AFTER_FIX',flush=True)
 print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
finally:
 for peer in reversed(workers):
  if peer.poll() is None:peer.terminate()
  try:peer.wait(timeout=4)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:peer.kill();peer.wait()
test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
assert os.geteuid()!=0
before=(os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net"),pathlib.Path("/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward").read_text())
process=subprocess.run(["unshare","-Urn","--",sys.executable,"-I","-B","checks/pmtud_scenario.py"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=65)
print(process.stdout,flush=True)
assert before==(os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net"),pathlib.Path("/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward").read_text())
assert process.returncode==0,process.stderr+process.stdout
